hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Consider indices with even parity and indices with odd parity separately.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Iterate across the string, adding each digit value to either the even accumulator or the odd accumulator based on its position index.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Return whether both sums are equal.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def isBalanced(self, num: str) -> bool:
        even_sum = sum(int(num[i]) for i in range(0, len(num), 2))
        odd_sum = sum(int(num[i]) for i in range(1, len(num), 2))
        return even_sum == odd_sum
```
